id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Thank you for waiting! We will now begin the first preliminary match!
"Team Vince and {var:1}! Team Underdigger and Abominable Showman! Take the stage!!
"Oh, Underdigger. Between this and the other day, we certainly seem to be bound by fate.
"Tch, the champion right off the bat. Just how unlucky can I be...
"Hey, partner. You know the plan? Leave the champion for later and beat that young guy to a pulp first.
"If it's just the champion alone, we still have a chance. Let's crush that Vince with our King Slime-class weight!
"Bello, bello, bellooo. If we win the tournament, the ladies will love us, bello. So let's do our best, belloon.
"Both teams are full of spirit! They seem to be ready!
